state: Normalized unitary-link/unit-sphere trajectory with actual varying positive norm weights; continuous tangent defects

norms.absolute: Integral abs(ell_q)+abs(ell_w); not terminal norm difference
norms.positive: Integral max(ell_q,0)+max(ell_w,0); pure base loss contributes no positive norm work
norms.floor: Each initial lower norm minus its absolute variation upper must be positive

parameter_variation: Integral rho_explicit+k_q*lambda_q+k_w*lambda_w, bounding spatial gradients of actual potential partial derivatives uniformly over the tube/norm box
defect_work: An upper bound for every prefix of signed dF[Y], or integral positive work; terminal cancellation insufficient

gauss.zero_source: Initial G=0 and S=0 pointwise/a.e.; small bounds do not repair the constraint

separate_obligations: Guaranteed joint-coverage initial and accumulated bounds
Matrix source/carrier realization if claiming G=Q
Certified manifold reconstruction for numerical defects
Non-constructor review and independent physical validation
excluded: Arbitrary numerical schemes or endpoint-only net work
Jumps without controlled bridges, nonunitary/off-sphere states
Physical source construction or constraint projection
